response.overview: Shawn, a foreigner who loves Korean culture, buys a home of his own with money he has slowly saved. He turns the spare room into a boarding house and welcomes Seon-mi and Mi-kyung as new members of the household. Drawn to his kindness and exotic charm, the two women quickly shed their awkwardness. Learning to understand each other's cultural differences and sharing everyday life, the three make their life under one roof bright and full of energy.
response.title: A Taste of Black: The Women Who Cry Out
